prompt:
Bamboo, the HerbLens panda mascot, in his signature canonical chibi design, enthusiastically taking a photo. He stands upright on two short stubby legs, holding a small chunky retro-style camera up in front of his face with both paws — the camera is a friendly cartoon shape, soft sage-green body with a rounded charcoal lens facing forward. One eye is squinted shut as if peering through the viewfinder; the other eye is open wide, big glossy black with ONE crisp symmetric white highlight, focused intently. A wide open-mouth grin of excitement (still no teeth shown, just a curved smile shape with a hint of pink tongue). Pink blush circles on both cheeks unchanged. One small bamboo-leaf tip peeks from behind each ear. The camera has no brand markings, no lens flare, no text.

RENDERING STYLE: Clean modern app-mascot illustration, like a premium iOS app icon. Flat base colors with smooth soft-shaded gradient shading (2-3 shade steps, airbrushed falloff). NO painterly brushstrokes, NO paper grain, NO watercolor texture, NO sketchy lines. Silhouette of panda + camera reads cleanly at thumbnail size. Subtle darker ambient-occlusion contour under arms and belly and beneath the camera, NO hard black outline. Warm single-source light from upper left. Character occupies about 75 percent of frame height, centered, with comfortable margins. Must read as the same Bamboo character as the canonical reference.
